targets.name: Kōsai Shippū
targets.action: Unleash accelerated crystal-laced shockwaves toward enemy target (source description: speed enhancement and crystal-laced shockwaves).
targets.dominant_silhouette: Three broad, staggered sweeping CRESCENT shockwave bands, each actively carrying integrated jagged crystal ridges rather than decorative gems.
targets.camera: Lateral shallow front/side three-quarter view; left-starting waves sweep toward near-right impact; dark negative gaps between exactly three bands.
targets.motion_axis: Left to right horizontal forward acceleration with impact at the near-right edge.
targets.secondary_effect: Sparse trailing hard-glass splinters showing recoil and speed.
targets.rendering_lock: LUMINOUS SILICATE / WARM-CORE REFRACTION: crisp premium TNR pixel/cel planes, dense deep teal-jade/cyan translucent mineral-glass facets, restrained bright amber and sun-gold internal refraction, navy-black negative space, full-bleed designed background; avoid frosted sapphire/ice look, text, frames, runes, generic floating gems; technique action always dominates.

sibling_exclusions.silhouette: Upright split crystal cocoon opening away from a dark central seam.
One refracted straight solar beam/lance, with no curved wave fan.
One continuous defensive round shell that deflects, not an ornamental floating gemstone.
Large opposing impaling cave teeth converging inward rather than a scenic cavern or closed sphere.

wrong_subject_exclusions: No warrior, human actor, face, body, hand, fingers or limbs (anatomy exception NONE).
No generic magic ring, unsupported floating rune or decorative faceted diamond.
No BBE ice flake, frost, sword or shackles composition.
